mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to replace an exterior door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of exterior door replacement varies widely based on the type of door material (steel, fiberglass, wood), its size, style, hardware choices, and any necessary frame repairs or modifications. Custom doors or those with advanced security features typically cost more. Hometelligent Inc. provides a detailed, itemized quote after an on-site assessment in the Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, or Emeryville area, ensuring transparency and addressing specific project requirements.
